info.title: SpeechNexus administration API
info.description:
Deployment-scoped administration and observation API. These routes do not
establish a user identity, role, or tenant boundary. A deployment may expose
them on a separate listener or route allowlist, but the API itself must not
pretend that hiding a navigation entry is authorization.

Model binding revisions, runtime instances, capacity manifests, and
qualification reports are separate resources. No response exposes private
artifact paths, engine endpoints, credentials, or arbitrary container
control.

post.summary: Create an immutable draft scenario-profile revision
post.description:
Creates the next immutable revision in a profile family. The request
carries `expected_latest_revision` for revision allocation; null is
valid only for a new family. An existing mismatch returns 409
`configuration_changed`. The new revision starts in publication
`draft` state and is not returned by the public profile list until it
is published. Replaying the same Idempotency-Key and canonical intent
returns the original revision; the same key with a different intent
returns 409 `idempotency_conflict`.

A recorded `configuration_changed` result remains the result of that
key even if the allocation head later changes. Original-key lookup
precedes revision allocation. Malformed JSON, unknown fields, invalid
path/header values and schema-invalid input return 400. A structurally
valid definition that violates cross-field profile rules returns 422.

An unreadable original result or uncertain commit returns 503
`profile_result_unknown`, with `retryable: false`. It does not establish
that no revision was created. There is no automatic retry, new key,
Operation or HTTP query-by-key recovery resource. A caller retaining
the original Idempotency-Key may explicitly replay this same POST with
the exact original intent and key to resolve its original result.
Without an original key, automatic recovery is not promised; a GET of
a candidate revision does not prove ownership of the original command.

201.description: Draft profile revision created, without validation or qualification evidence.

get.summary: Get a draft or historical profile revision
get.description:
Read only the explicitly named immutable revision; never allocate,
publish or activate one. Invalid path/header/query values return 400.
Return 404 only when an authoritative read confirms that this revision
is absent. Unreadable metadata returns 503 `profile_unavailable`, with
`retryable: true` for this same fixed GET; it cannot be reported as 404
or used to infer that an earlier create did not commit. No Operation
recovery or default/current revision selection is implied.

kind.description: duplex profiles are valid only for realtime sessions that reserve both ASR and TTS resources atomically.

required_capabilities.description: Capability requirements. Capability names are unique within a profile revision; producer validation rejects the same capability appearing twice with different constraints.

override_allowlist.description: Only these paths may be overridden by a request. Omitted paths are not overridable even when the value is within a declared range.

override_ranges.description: Allowed override ranges or enum domains. Keys must be a subset of override_allowlist; a range for a non-overridable path is a configuration error. An allowlisted path without an entry is bounded only by ProfileParameters and the binding domain. Producer validation requires minimum <= maximum when both are present.

slo_ref.description: Reference to the deployment SLO document or qualification report scenario. It is not a numeric promise in this schema.

External_shared_capability_domains_schem.description: Scenario profiles do not claim the model-binding-only best_effort tier.

max_segment_ms.description: Must be greater than or equal to preview_interval_ms and is further bounded by the binding, auxiliary capabilities, and workspace policy at admission. JSON Schema cannot express the cross-field comparison; contract tests and runtime validation enforce it.

External_shared_identifiers_schema_json_.description: Opaque stable resource identifier. Prefixes are descriptive, not authorization claims.
Monotonic decimal revision represented as a string.

External_scenario_profile_schema_json_Ro.title: ScenarioProfileRevision
External_scenario_profile_schema_json_Ro.description: Immutable scenario preset revision. A profile composes explicit ASR/TTS policy parameters with capability requirements, validation evidence, and publication lifecycle metadata. It never carries scheduling priority, engine endpoints, model paths, credentials, or user identity.

profile_id.description: Stable profile family identifier. The pair (profile_id, revision) is immutable.

External_shared_errors_schema_json_Opera.description: Query GET /v1/nexus/operations/{operation_id}. This identity is the original execution; retrying never creates a second execution.

External_shared_receipts_schema_json_Pub.description: Allowlisted public projection only. Omit content, prompt, instructions, vendor payloads and private runtime identities. Unknown facts go into stable missing/unknown paths, never arbitrary dictionaries.

XRequestId.description: Validated client request ID or a server-generated correlation ID.

Unauthorized.description: Shared service credential required or invalid.

ProfileDraftConflict.description: The original key conflicts or its allocation CAS was rejected; no new revision.

UnprocessableEntity.description: Invalid binding, capacity, qualification, or policy composition.

ProfileCreationUnknown.description: Original creation result unreadable or commit uncertain; retain original intent/key.

ProfileReadUnavailable.description: Fixed revision could not be read; this does not confirm absence.

SharedServiceKey.description: Optional deployment-wide shared credential; not a user identity.
